title: Beware Desire
coreMove: Desire becomes bondage when it commands attention; regain stillness by observing the urge, naming what it can control, and choosing without serving it.

exampleSpecs.domain: diner prep counter before a lunch rush
exampleSpecs.audience: Bruno, a cook with scarce attention before service
exampleSpecs.stakes: Praise work could steal the minutes needed for steady service.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Before action begins, Bruno allocates scarce prep time by self-mastery instead of desire for applause.

exampleSpecs.domain: parking garage pay station before a status meeting
exampleSpecs.audience: Maelle, a professional caught between cost and ambition
exampleSpecs.stakes: Either route carries a real cost, and craving can make the status prize seem like freedom.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Maelle uses choiceless awareness to see both bad options without letting desire edit the scene.

exampleSpecs.domain: barber chair before a public presentation
exampleSpecs.audience: Odilon, a speaker tempted to make appearance the verdict
exampleSpecs.stakes: A useful haircut can become a master if the mirror decides whether he may enter the room.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Two named people let the lesson emerge from talk about image, observation, and desire.

exampleSpecs.domain: city permit counter after a long wait
exampleSpecs.audience: Warren, an applicant expecting relief from approval
exampleSpecs.stakes: The desired outcome can arrive and still leave wanting in charge.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: The expected calm after approval breaks when desire moves to the next object.

exampleSpecs.domain: rowing boathouse rack during lineup posting
exampleSpecs.audience: Telesphore, a rower watching craving turn a seat into a verdict
exampleSpecs.stakes: A lineup sheet can be read as information or as proof of personal worth.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: A short exchange uses Bruce Lee's observation practice to loosen desire around status.

exampleSpecs.domain: campus advising desk during course registration
exampleSpecs.audience: Amelia, a student-athlete tempted by a prestige-heavy term
exampleSpecs.stakes: A course plan can serve learning or serve the craving to look impressive.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: A routine registration script is interrupted, paused, and restarted through self-mastery.
